name: (15) Animalism — 3 Advanced — Eyes of the Forest

system.description: The Gangrel spreads her awareness through a defined geographic domain (a valley, mountain, wood), seeing/hearing through its animals and insects and gaining safety from direct attack while interred; significant damage to the domain (fire, strip mining, chemical contamination) instead damages the vampire and may force her out. If two Animalism masters claim the same domain, the one with greater Willpower prevails.
